source_clause: NOPR4.) Pressing “Switch Users” will take the user to the “All Profiles” tab in the Profile Section.
leaf_desc_037: NOPR4.) Pressing “Switch Users” will take the user to the “All Profiles” tab in the Profile Section.
reasoning: 驗證目標：6.5（NOPR4）—— 按 Switch Users 進入 Profile 區之“All Profiles” 分頁。關鍵情境條件：上次分頁須**不是** “All Profiles”。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 為單一導向斷言；切換 profile 之後續行為屬 5.3（`SWE1-HMI-PROF-022`），本條只到達分頁為止。

tcs.tc_title: Switch Users opens the All Profiles tab
tcs.test_item:
Switch Users opens the All Profiles tab

(Verifies that Switch Users on the Welcome popup closes it and opens the All Profiles tab of the Profile section)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The Welcome popup with the Switch Users button is displayed
2. The last used tab of the active Profile is the “Edit Profile” tab
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press Switch Users on the Welcome popup
2. Read the screen and check which tab of the Profile section is shown
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Welcome popup is closed and the Profile section is opened
2. The “All Profiles” tab is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **pre-condition 刻意把上次分頁設為 “Edit Profile”** ——否則 5.1 之 latch（上次分頁）與本條之「固定到 All Profiles」會給出相同結果，兩者不可分辨。此設置亦使本條與 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-055`（導向上次分頁）之判別力各自成立。
